title: Warby Parker Appoints Adrian Mitchell as Chief Financial Officer
summary: Warby Parker Inc. (NYSE: WRBY), a direct-to-consumer lifestyle brand focused on vision for all, today announced the appointment of Adrian Mitchell as Chief Financial Officer, effective February 10, 2026. His appointment strengthens Warby Parker's leadership team as the company continues executing its strategic vision, building on a track record of retail and product innovation while expanding into new categories, including the launch of its first AI glasses. Adrian Mitchell, Chief Financial Officer Mitchell has more than 25 years of experience leading some of the world’s most recognizable consumer brands. He brings a unique balance of strategic acumen, operational rigor, and financial expertise, allowing him to translate growth strategies into long-term shareholder value.
